name: Mohedas de Granadilla (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a green stripe in the lower third, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Mohedas de Granadilla (flowers on white and a pomegranate).
history: Municipal flag of Mohedas de Granadilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Mohedas de Granadilla arms — flowers and pomegranate
